workspace.subdomain.description: Your Fellow workspace subdomain: the `acme` in https://acme.fellow.app

credentials.apiKey.description: Where your Fellow API key lives (User Settings → Developer API). A reference, never the key

storage.recaps.path.description: Where recaps and note exports are written; relative paths resolve from the repo root

storage.transcripts.path.description: Where transcript exports are written. Transcripts are verbatim and often sensitive, so an absolute path outside the repo is safest

projects.description: Named project scopes that filter meetings by title and attendees; see references/project-scoping.md

defaultProject.description: The project scope applied when --project is not given; empty means no filtering

label.description: A readable name for the project

title.description: Meeting titles that place a meeting in or out of the project

people.description: Attendee emails or @domains that place a meeting in or out of the project

fallback.description: What a meeting no rule matches counts as

include.description: Matches that include: a plain substring, or /regex/flags
